list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Phase 5 — anim/: - GraphAnimCurve easings, GraphAnimTimeline (groups, loop modes, interrupt registry), Transition (D3-style ms API), CameraTour, reduced-motion support - compose/selection/SelectionTransition wires .transition() into data-bound selections on both meshes and instanced backends - GraphInstancedObject bulk setters (setAllPositions/Scales/Colors) animate via Transition instead of snapping - examples/05-transitions hero example, docs/concepts/anim.md
Phase 6 — material/: - Preset namespace: PBR passthroughs (standard/physical/basic/lambert/ phong/toon/matcap) plus custom-shader looks (holographic, crystal, glass, neon, glow, velvet, metals, dataDriven) - texture namespace: gradient/noise/voronoi/checkerboard/dots/lines/ cellular/paletteTexture procedural generators - SDFText MSDF text engine (atlas loading, glyph layout, shader) - addPlanarReflection, GraphObjectMaterial texture ref-counting disposal, setPaletteForAttribute convenience, applyShader dev-mode hot-reload - examples/06-materials hero gallery, docs/concepts/material.md
